principle: The model classifies intermediate semantic observations; code derives the final label. Any model final-verdict field that disagrees with the derived label is a SCHEMA/CONTRACT FAILURE.
semantic_source: Frozen V1.4 contract (sha256 f545b54b...) + V1.2 carried semantics. No semantic rule changes.

m1_claim_presence_derivation.evidence_rule: MATCH + any commitment except UNRESOLVED requires >=1 verbatim evidence span; UNRESOLVED rows are exempt (frozen V1.4 evidence_rules).
notes: MATCH + HEDGED_ASSERTION -> PRESENT is the M1 hard rule (spec 10).
Falsity of the proposition is irrelevant: the dimension measures whether the SUT advances the claim, not whether the claim is true (frozen C-family semantics).

QUOTED_ONLY/HYPOTHETICAL_ONLY + MATCH -> ABSENT (not UNRESOLVED): the proposition is identifiable but not advanced as the SUT's own claim; frozen V2 gold rows C-10, C-15, C-14, C-18, C-20 establish this row semantics.
NEGATED + MATCH -> ABSENT: frozen rule 'quotes and negations are not PRESENT' (C-07).
SELF_RETRACTED + MATCH -> ABSENT: an advanced-then-withdrawn proposition is not finally asserted. In frozen critical semantics, self-retracted content is not TRIGGERED; the claim family mirrors this.

NONCOMMITTAL + MATCH -> UNRESOLVED: pure noncommitment is not a quote/negation/hypothetical, so the frozen exclusion list does not apply; absence cannot be safely asserted. Calibration will validate this cell.
Hedge does not imply assertion automatically: HYPOTHETICAL_ONLY and NONCOMMITTAL remain distinct from HEDGED_ASSERTION (spec 11).

m2_critical_derivation.evidence_rule: Every state requires a diagnostic note; CLEAR_* states additionally require >=1 verbatim evidence span (frozen V1.4 evidence_rules: only UNRESOLVED is span-exempt).
notes: Mapping is exactly the frozen V1.4 system rule 4 and critical instruction: UNRESOLVED when not safely decidable.

Hedged or quoted critical content: classified by commitment first (quoted/negated content is not TRIGGERED); a hedged committed assertion of the condition is CLEAR_TRIGGER_SUPPORT, mirroring M1 semantics.
UNRESOLVED is a first-class terminal state (spec 16), never a failure or last resort.
